summary: Preinstall beacon exfiltrates host and user identifiers to dcf.rootxravi.com
details: The package's preinstall script (node index.js) runs automatically on npm install and transmits the installer's hostname, OS username, install directory path, timestamp, and package name to the third-party domain dcf.rootxravi.com via an HTTPS POST to /dcf/<pkg> and via a DNS lookup of <hex>.dcf.rootxravi.com. The behavior is a dependency-confusion beacon: it fires without user consent and carries identifying information off the installer's host to an attacker-controlled domain. The package identifies itself as a security-research proof of concept, but the code performs real installer-side identifier exfiltration regardless of self-labeling.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
